verdict.rationale: Deepgram has a first-party guide for transcribing live streaming audio in real time [deepgram-docs-2], plus an API Playground for live streaming transcription [deepgram-docs-25] and a CLI that can stream live audio [deepgram-docs-18]. Its documented wss:// agent endpoint [deepgram-docs-3] shows WebSocket streaming is part of the platform, though that endpoint is for voice agents rather than plain transcription. missing for 10: the evidence never quotes the transcription WebSocket endpoint URL or its message protocol (interim/final results, latency), and there is no independent hands-on corroboration of live streaming transcription.
